resources.string: Your models. Your conversations.\nConnected on your terms.
Add the address of your Guilty Spark server. You can save it now and connect when your Nebula network is ready.
Use the private IP and port shown in the desktop app’s Phone connection screen, or an HTTPS address.
Nebula connects your phone to your server. Turn it on when you’re ready, then come back here. This app uses that connection.
Your models run on your server. Your access code is entered directly in its sign-in screen.
Address saved. Connect whenever your server is ready.
Sign out of this server on this phone? Your saved server address and server conversations will stay available.
Open this link in your browser?
To export or download workspace files, use “Open in browser” from the menu.
The server’s secure connection could not be verified. Check its certificate or use its private Nebula IP with HTTP.
Your Spark is out of reach. Check that the server is running and your phone is connected to Nebula or the same private network.
The workspace could not load. Check your connection and try again.
The workspace closed unexpectedly. Reconnect to restore it from your server.
No browser is available to open this link.
Return to connection settings? Your conversations stay on your server. An unsent message may need to be entered again.
